negative_blobs.name: header_magic_bit_flipped

negative_blobs.name: header_file_id_bit_flipped
negative_blobs.why: a bit of file_id in the descriptor header was changed: it no longer equals the descriptor id

negative_blobs.name: header_commitment_wrong
negative_blobs.why: the commitment in the header is not the one derived from K (source header equals the descriptor header)

negative_blobs.name: header_stream_len_not_padme
negative_blobs.why: stream_len is 1023 but padme(1023) is 1024; header, blob and commitment are otherwise consistent

negative_blobs.name: header_total_chunks_incoherent
negative_blobs.why: total_chunks is 2 but ceil(1024 / CHUNK) is 1

negative_blobs.name: source_header_bit_flipped
negative_blobs.why: the blob header differs from the descriptor header by one bit of file_id

negative_blobs.name: source_header_other_file
negative_blobs.why: the source delivers the blob of another file with the same size

negative_blobs.name: chunk_ciphertext_bit_flipped
negative_blobs.why: one bit of the ciphertext of chunk 0 was changed

negative_blobs.name: chunk_tag_bit_flipped
negative_blobs.why: one bit of the GCM tag of chunk 0 was changed

negative_blobs.name: blob_tag_truncated
negative_blobs.why: the blob is one byte shorter than 64 + stream_len + 16 x total_chunks

negative_blobs.name: blob_extended
negative_blobs.why: the blob is one byte longer than 64 + stream_len + 16 x total_chunks

negative_blobs.name: padding_not_zero
negative_blobs.why: the last padding byte is 0x01: every tag verifies, but padding must be zero

negative_blobs.name: chunks_swapped
negative_blobs.why: chunks 0 and 1 (both full size) swapped: the index in nonce and AAD no longer matches

negative_blobs.name: chunk_duplicated

negative_blobs.name: last_chunk_removed

negative_blobs.name: last_chunk_final_flag_zero
negative_blobs.why: the last chunk was encrypted with final = 0

negative_blobs.name: foreign_chunk_same_index
negative_blobs.why: chunk 1 comes from another file of the same size (other K and file_id), at the same index

negative_chunks.name: chunk_tag_truncated
negative_chunks.why: the chunk is one byte short (truncated tag)

negative_chunks.name: chunk_index_out_of_range
negative_chunks.why: index 1 of a one-chunk file: dropped without allocating anything

receive_order: descriptor fields and sz range -> bad_descriptor
magic, file_id == id, stream_len range, total_chunks == ceil(stream_len / CHUNK) -> bad_header
blob length == 64 + stream_len + 16 x total_chunks -> size_mismatch
each chunk: index < total_chunks (else discard), exact length and GCM open -> chunk_auth
